name: Izayoi ~Hime Miko Senka~
source:
Main character is a young man who lives in the mountains as a hermit. One day two girls lost their way and got to hero's house. They insisted that they did not want to go home, and so they stayed in the mountains. On the night of that day main character felt a strange hypnotic impulse in his body and incredible lust force awakened in him.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-november-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一位住在山里的隐士年轻人。有一天，两个女孩迷了路，来到了英雄的家。他们坚持不想回家，就留在山里。那天晚上，主角感到体内有一种奇怪的催眠冲动，不可思议的情欲力量在他体内苏醒。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-november-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
